cues.en: With introductions, hello world, and a bit of basic information behind us, we now are ready
cues.zh: 介紹、Hello World，以及一些基本資訊都完成後，我們現在已經準備好，

cues.en: to tackle the four main AI concepts to learn as a developer.
cues.zh: 開始學習開發者需要掌握的 AI 四大核心概念。

cues.en: And this is what will be the main part of the rest of this course.
cues.zh: 這也會是接下來課程的主要內容。

cues.en: As I've mentioned before, there's, in my opinion, four main AI concepts, those being chat, tool
cues.zh: 如前所述，我認為 AI 有四大核心概念，分別是對話、工具

cues.en: calling, structured output, and rack.
cues.zh: 呼叫、結構化輸出，以及 RAG。

cues.en: In this video, I will just briefly mention what they are, so you are aware, and then there will be different sections dedicated for
cues.zh: 這段影片先簡單介紹它們是什麼，讓你有初步概念；之後會各有專門章節，

cues.en: going deeper into all four of these.
cues.zh: 深入探討這四項主題。

cues.en: So the first one being chat, and you might think, well, I'm not building a chatbot or anything.
cues.zh: 第一個是對話。你可能會想：「我又沒有要做聊天機器人。」

cues.en: Chat is just a common word for a request response capability.
cues.zh: Chat 其實只是請求與回應能力的一個通稱。

cues.en: It doesn't need to be question and answer, it can also be action and response back to that action, and so on.
cues.zh: 不一定是問答，也可以是執行動作，再接收該動作的回應等等。

cues.en: So you could make a chatbot, but it could also just run behind the scenes every time some webhook is being triggered in your system.
cues.zh: 所以可以做聊天機器人，也可以在系統收到 Webhook 時，在背景自動執行。

cues.en: You need to get some data out from a system and paste it into another system.
cues.zh: 例如從某個系統取得資料，再放進另一個系統。

cues.en: So chat is the bare bones of what we're going to do here.
cues.zh: 因此，對話是我們這裡最基本的操作。

cues.en: We're going to talk about conversations, where we have back and forwards, instructions, and prompt engineering in that section.
cues.zh: 這個章節會介紹多輪來回的對話、指示，以及提示詞工程。

cues.en: The next concept is tool calling, and that's the ability to call user code.
cues.zh: 第二個概念是工具呼叫，也就是呼叫開發者程式碼的能力。

cues.en: So we can have live interactions with other systems, or we can ask for more data.
cues.zh: 讓我們即時與其他系統互動，或要求更多資料。

cues.en: So tools can either be informational, meaning I need to go up and grab some data, like a web search, or it can be
cues.zh: 工具可以是資訊型的，例如取得資料、搜尋網路；也可以是

cues.en: an action tool that can go in and make, for example, some kind of order in an invoice system, or in a back end
cues.zh: 執行動作的工具，例如在發票系統或網路商店的後台

cues.en: of a webshop, or something for that.
cues.zh: 建立訂單等操作。

cues.en: We can make them ourselves.
cues.zh: 我們可以自行開發工具，

cues.en: We can use the MCP protocol to use tools.
cues.zh: 也可以透過 MCP 協定使用工具，

cues.en: We can use other agents as tools.
cues.zh: 還可以把其他代理程式當作工具。

cues.en: So it's a very, very important concept, so it has its own section with a lot of details in it.
cues.zh: 這個概念非常重要，所以會有專門章節，介紹許多細節。

cues.en: The third concept is structured output.
cues.zh: 第三個概念是結構化輸出。

cues.en: Some people put that in together with chat.
cues.zh: 有些人會把它歸類在對話裡，

cues.en: I find it so important and one of the most used of the features, so I put it in its own section.
cues.zh: 但我認為它非常重要，也是最常使用的功能之一，因此獨立成一章。

cues.en: So structured output is more about whenever we saw hello world, we saw that sometimes it said the capital of France is Paris, other
cues.zh: 在 Hello World 裡，我們看過模型有時回答「法國的首都是巴黎」，

cues.en: times it just said the word Paris, and so on.
cues.zh: 有時卻只回答「巴黎」等等。

cues.en: So we need to steer the model even more when we get data back.
cues.zh: 因此，取得資料時，需要更進一步引導模型。

cues.en: So we often don't just want text or markdown back.
cues.zh: 我們往往不只是想拿到一般文字或 Markdown，

cues.en: We actually want some structure in it, and that is what structured output gives, in that it can give it back as JSON.
cues.zh: 而是希望資料有一定結構。結構化輸出就能做到，例如讓模型回傳 JSON。

cues.en: There's not much more to it, but it's very important that it's being learned, and also how you steer structured output.
cues.zh: 原理不複雜，但學會它，以及如何引導結構化輸出，非常重要。

cues.en: The final concept is the biggest one, meaning that while it's one of the first that came along, being Retrieval Augmented Generation, or RAC
cues.zh: 最後一個概念是範圍最大的，也是很早就出現的概念：Retrieval Augmented Generation，

cues.en: for short, is that we can give our own data.
cues.zh: 簡稱 RAG，也就是檢索增強生成，讓我們能提供自己的資料。

cues.en: So AIs know a lot.
cues.zh: AI 知道很多事情，

cues.en: They can know capital of France.
cues.zh: 例如法國的首都，

cues.en: They can know every little detail around the world, but they cannot talk with your company data, your personal data, and so on, without
cues.zh: 也知道許多世界上的細節；但若沒有

cues.en: us giving it the data up front.
cues.zh: 事先提供資料，就無法回答你的公司資料或私人資料。

cues.en: And that is what RAC is, that we begin to take our own data, put them into vector stores, do similarity searches on them,
cues.zh: RAG 的做法，就是把自己的資料放進向量儲存區，再進行相似度搜尋，

cues.en: and so on.
cues.zh: 以及相關處理。

cues.en: There's a lot of concept in that area, so it's one of the bigger sections, but we will go into every single little detail so you can be successful with RAC as
cues.zh: 這個領域有很多概念，所以是比較大的章節。我們會逐一介紹細節，讓你也能成功運用 RAG。

cues.en: well.
cues.zh: 這部分也會完整說明。

cues.en: So that's the four main concepts which we'll now dive into.
cues.zh: 以上就是四大核心概念，接下來逐一深入。
